final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), compared AS (SELECT record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_share_excess FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share
